info.headline: Notify NYC - MTA Disruption - N & D Train Service (BK)
info.description:
Notification issued 10-09-2026 at 11:37 AM.
Due to a switch problem, expect delays and service changes in both directions on N and D train service near Surf Avenue and Stillwell Avenue in Brooklyn. Consider alternate routes and allow for additional travel time.
For more information, please visit www.mta.info.
